{{Quote|He's ''gone,'' doctor! The couch ''restraints'' have been ''broken''...|C-3PO, after Luke Skywalker broke free of an auto-med couch|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 20">[[Star Wars (1977) 20|''Star Wars'' (1977) 20]]</ref>}}
An '''auto-med couch''' was used in [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]] for medical procedures, and to apply medication to patients. [[The Wheel hospital]] had an auto-med couch. On [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade's]] orders [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was restrained in an auto-med couch on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] and given drugs to keep him in a trance. Skywalker was able to overcome both drugs and restraints and escape.<ref name="SWM21" />
